title: HSRM: Hidden-State Reward Models for Test-Time Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.30841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can often generate plausible mathematical reasoning traces, but reliably identifying the correct solution among multiple candidates remains a key challenge. Existing test-time reasoning pipelines typically rely on text-based verifiers that re-read each generated solution, making verification an expensive component of inference. Prior work has shown, however, that LLMs often encode correctness-related signals in their internal representations, including awareness of when their own answers are likely to be wrong. Building on this observation, we introduce HSRM, a lightweight hidden-state reward model that verifies candidate solutions by directly reading the generator's internal representations rather than re-processing its text. translated_title: HSRM：用于测试时验证的隐藏状态奖励模型
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通常能够生成看似合理的数学推理过程，但在多个候选答案中可靠地识别出正确解仍然是一个关键挑战。现有的测试时推理流程通常依赖于基于文本的验证器重新阅读每个生成的解答，这使得验证成为推理中代价高昂的组成部分。然而，先前的研究表明，大语言模型往往在其内部表示中编码了与正确性相关的信号，包括对自身答案何时可能出错的感知。基于这一观察，我们提出了HSRM，一种轻量级的隐藏状态奖励模型，它通过直接读取生成器的内部表示而非重新处理其文本来验证候选解答。HSRM在推理步骤边界处从冻结的生成器中提取隐藏状态，并使用一个小型Transformer编码器对候选答案进行排序。它由自生成的轨迹训练而成……
tldr: 提出HSRM，一种轻量级隐藏状态奖励模型，通过在推理步骤边界直接读取冻结生成器的内部表示并用小型Transformer编码器对候选解答排序，摆脱了昂贵的基于文本的重新验证，实现高效的测试时验证。
en_tdlr: HSRM is a lightweight hidden-state reward model that verifies candidate solutions by directly reading the frozen generator's internal representations at reasoning-step boundaries and ranking them with a small Transformer encoder, enabling efficient test-time verification without costly text-based re-reading.
